task: Assess the credit and counterparty risk of Beyond Meat

merged.claim: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a public company (Nasdaq: BYND) with no PE or single controlling sponsor and no verified change of control. The 2025 debt exchange heavily diluted existing shareholders.
Largest holders per WallStreetZen (2026): Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XIV LLC 28.61%, Seth Goldman 10.60%, CEO Ethan Brown 5.10%.

Millennium Management LLC, Millennium Group Management LLC and Israel A. Englander reported beneficial ownership of 957,442 shares (5.2%) under Schedule 13G as of 2026-09-21, not filed to influence control.
FY2025 net revenues were $275.5M, down 15.6% YoY.
FY2025 loss from operations was $333.6M (operating margin -121.1%).
FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA was -$179.3M (-65.1% of net revenues).
Cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash were $217.5M as of 2025-12-31.
Total debt carrying value (net of discount; 2027 Notes, 2030 PIK notes, DDTL) was $415.7M as of 2025-12-31.
Net cash used in operating activities in FY2025 was $144.9M.
FY2025 net income of $219.0M included a $548.7M non-cash gain on debt restructuring; about $17.6M of debt issuance costs were expensed.
Q1 2026 net revenues were $58.2M, down 15.3% YoY.
Q1 2026 loss from operations was $41.1M.
Q1 2026 net loss was $28.5M.
Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash were $205.8M as of 2026-03-28.
Total debt was $411.6M as of 2026-03-28 (Q1 2026 10-Q).
Stockholders' deficit was $21.1M as of 2026-03-28.
Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-27) net revenue was $68.832M, down 8.2% YoY.
Q2 2026 operating loss was $30.806M.
Q2 2026 net income was $16.4M, driven primarily by a $57.7M non-cash gain on debt extinguishment from 2030 Notes conversions rather than profitable operations.
Q2 2026 Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) was approximately -$27.7M (-40.2% of net revenues).
H1 2026 gain on debt extinguishment was $63.8M.
Unrestricted cash and cash equivalents were $171.369M as of 2026-06-27.
Current restricted cash was $5.516M as of 2026-06-27.
Non-current restricted cash was $9.25M as of 2026-06-27.
Cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash were $186.1M as of 2026-06-27.
Total debt outstanding was $323.8M carrying value (net of discounts and issuance costs, excluding leases; 2030 PIK notes, 2027 Notes, DDTL) as of 2026-06-27.
$29.459M of 0% 2027 convertible notes remained outstanding as of 2026-06-27, maturing 2027-03-15.
The delayed-draw term loan was fully drawn as of 2026-06-27, with $0 remaining availability.
The delayed-draw term loan had $110.9M outstanding including accrued PIK interest as of 2026-06-27.
Loan and Security Agreement of 2025-05-07 with Unprocessed Foods, LLC (Ahimsa DDTL) for up to $100.0M; $40.0M drawn 2025-06-26 and $60.0M on 2025-09-18 ($100.0M drawn in FY2025).
Net cash used in operating activities in H1 2026 was $23.2M (vs $58.0M in H1 2025); management expects to keep operating at a loss for the foreseeable future.

Management stated in the June 27, 2026 10-Q that existing cash plus anticipated operating cash flows should fund operations for the next 12 months, conditional on revenue, cash-flow and cost assumptions.
Debt agreements carry a $15.0M minimum-liquidity covenant, tested quarterly.
Company reported compliance with covenants of the 2030 Notes and the Loan and Security Agreement as of 2026-06-27.
The 2030 second-lien notes mature 2030-10-15 and bear 7% interest (9.5% when paid in kind).
Debt agreements include a $60.0M cap on cash used to repay the 2027 Notes at maturity, subject to stated exceptions.

Oct 2025 exchange offer early settlement (2025-10-13): $1,114,603,000 (96.92%) of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 exchanged for $196.2M of new 7.00% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Toggle Notes due 2030 plus 316,150,176 shares (total new notes $208.7M including $12.5M SteerCo premium); covenants and certain events of default were stripped from the remaining 2027 Notes indenture.

Final settlement of the exchange offer on 2025-10-30: 97.44% of 2027 notes exchanged, $209.721M of 7.00% second-lien 2030 notes issued (including steering-committee premium) and 317,834,446 common shares issued, leaving $29.459M of 2027 notes; a major restructuring with substantial dilution.
The Oct 2025 exchange offer was determined to qualify as a troubled debt restructuring (ASC 470-60).
Reuters reported the debt swap was launched to help avoid near-term default and hugely diluted the stock.
About $148.7M net proceeds were received from ATM common stock sales during FY2025.
On 2026-08-05 the company disclosed it no longer satisfies Form S-3 eligibility and cannot access its ATM Program, limiting financing flexibility.

On 2026-08-11 the company effected a 1-for-30 reverse stock split and authorized-share reduction to regain Nasdaq minimum bid compliance; conversion rates of the 2027 and 2030 convertible notes and warrants were proportionately adjusted.

Second supplemental indenture executed 2026-08-10 removing certain restrictions on repurchasing or exchanging 2027 notes for cash and/or equity and extending the conversion interest make-whole period to 2029-01-15.

On 2026-09-23 the company entered exchange agreements to retire about $15.0M principal of remaining 0% 2027 Convertible Notes at 96% of face value, settled in common stock (1,097,444 shares initially, up to 848,265 more at final settlement around Sept 28, subject to closing conditions; completion not confirmed).
Beyond Meat has no public credit rating from S&P, Moody's or Fitch on the issuer or its convertible notes (0% due 2027; 7% second lien PIK toggle due 2030); notes appear unrated.
On 2025-02-27 the company laid off 6% of its workforce (~44 employees) and suspended operations in China (~20 jobs, ~95% of local workforce).

Aug 2025: another layoff (44 employees, ~6% of global workforce, ~$0.8-1.3M severance, ~$7M annualized savings); AlixPartners MD John Boken appointed interim Chief Transformation Officer, targeting EBITDA-positivity in H2 2026.

Company ceased operational activities in China at end of 2025 and is winding down the facility and lease; it reported continuing charges from the China cessation and a partial headquarters lease termination, with workforce reductions, product-line exits and footprint optimization.
Material weakness in internal control over financial reporting disclosed 2025-11-12 (inadequate technical resources for complex transactions); Q3 2025 earnings delayed about a week.
$77.4M of non-cash impairment charges recorded in Q3 2025.
Corporate controller and principal accounting officer Yi (Jevy) Luo was terminated 2025-12-18; CFO Lubi Kutua assumed principal accounting officer duties.
Further material weaknesses were disclosed with the delayed FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-04-09).

As of 2026-06-27 (10-Q filed 2026-08-06) disclosure controls were not effective: two material weaknesses remain unremediated (non-routine/complex transactions accounting; inventory valuation/data integrity), with corrections to comparative-period accounting.
Reuters (2025-10-23): annual sales have declined since 2022, the company has never had an annual profit, its 'survival hangs in the balance', and it has never flagged going-concern risk.
Customer-loss signal (Aug 2025): reports that McDonald's removed McPlant from its Austrian menu and is running out its Beyond Meat contract; Q2 2025 US retail revenue dropped ~27%.

Creditsafe data: days-beyond-terms rose from 8 days in Aug 2024 to 19 days in Jul 2025 vs a 12-day industry average, indicating possible liquidity pressure; the company said it was not planning to file for bankruptcy.
Food Dive (2024-08-21), citing Creditsafe data, reported 36% of the company's 2024 bills were at least 91 days overdue; the company called the figures highly inaccurate and disputed them.

Sonate trademark litigation: jury verdict 2025-11-24 awarded $23.5M actual damages and $15.4M disgorgement against Beyond Meat, which recorded a $38.9M litigation accrual; post-trial motions were pending per the June 2026 10-Q.

On 2026-09-18 a federal court entered a $15.4375M judgment against Beyond Meat in the Sonate trademark case ($37,500 actual damages plus $15.4M disgorgement), subject to possible further motions or appeals.
Settled a former co-manufacturer dispute in its favour for $11M: $4M received in June 2026 and $7.1M including interest received 2026-07-10.
CreditRiskMonitor's undated preview flags tax-lien filings against Beyond Meat, Inc. with no date, amount or jurisdiction; unverified screening flag only.

Leadership transition: COO Brijesh Krishnaswamy began full-time on 2026-09-30; interim Chief Transformation Officer John Boken (named 'David Boken' in source A) stepped down effective 2026-10-07, with responsibilities reassigned.

c1.note: BYND is public and no single holder controls it. Kleiner is the largest at about 29%. I did not check the other claim details, such as the dilutive 2025 exchange or the absence of a change of control, against the primary filings.

c2.note: The page shows Kleiner 28.61%, Goldman 10.60% and Brown 5.10%.

c3.note: The Schedule 13G has an event date of 09/21/2026, Millennium Management LLC as a reporting person, 957,442 shares and 5.2%. It is filed under Rule 13d-1(c), a passive-investor filing. I did not read the rest of the filing, so the Group Management and Englander names and the not-to-influence-control statement are unchecked.

c4.note: FY2025 net revenues were $275.5M, down 15.6%, per the company press release.

c5.note: FY2025 loss from operations was $333.6M, a margin of -121.1%, per the press release.

c6.note: The press release states FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $179.3M, or -65.1% of net revenues.

c7.note: The release gives cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash as $217.5M at 12/31/2025.

c8.note: The release gives total outstanding carrying value of debt, net of debt discount, as $415.7M. It says this includes the undiscounted future cash flows of the new 2030 Notes. The component breakdown (2027 Notes, 2030 PIK notes, DDTL) was not itemised in the text I read.

c9.note: The release states net cash used in operating activities was $144.9M in 2025.

c10.note: The release confirms FY2025 net income of $219.0M and a $548.7M non-cash gain on debt restructuring. I could not find the $17.6M of expensed debt issuance costs in the release or in search results. The only 17.6 in the release is an unrelated U.S. revenue percentage.

c11.note: The press release (May 6, 2026) states net revenues of $58.2M, down 15.3% YoY.

c12.note: The release states a loss from operations of $41.1M.

c13.note: The release states a net loss of $28.5M.

c14.note: The 10-Q summary shows cash of $191.0M plus restricted cash of $4.4M and $10.4M, which sums to $205.8M as of 2026-03-28.

c15.note: The 10-Q shows 2027 Notes of $29.5M, 2030 Notes of $300.5M and delayed draw term loans of $81.7M, which sum to about $411.6M. These are carrying values net of discount, not principal.

c16.note: The Q1 2026 10-Q summary shows a $21.1M stockholders' deficit at March 28, 2026. I did not check it against the SEC filing itself.

c17.note: The release gives Q2 net revenues of $68,832K, down 8.2% from $74,958K.

c18.note: The release gives a Q2 loss from operations of $30.8M. The exact $30.806M figure was not seen, but it rounds correctly.

c19.note: The release gives net income of $16.4M, driven primarily by a $57.7M non-cash gain on debt extinguishment from 2030 Notes conversions.

c20.note: The release gives Q2 Adjusted EBITDA of -$27.7M, or -40.2% of net revenues.

c21.note: The Q2 2026 10-Q income statement shows a six-month gain on debt extinguishment of $63,789,000 (Q2 alone was $57.7M).

c22.note: The 10-Q balance sheet shows cash and cash equivalents of $171,369K at 2026-06-27.

c23.note: The 10-Q balance sheet shows current restricted cash of $5,516K.

c24.note: The 10-Q balance sheet shows non-current restricted cash of $9,250K.

c25.note: The press release gives $186.1M including restricted cash, which matches 171.369 + 5.516 + 9.25 = 186.135.

c26.note: The Q2 2026 press release states total debt carrying value net of discount was $323.8M at 2026-06-27. The balance sheet lines also sum to it: 29.5 + 208.7 + 85.6.

c27.note: Search summary of the 10-Q gives $29,459,000 of 2027 Notes outstanding at 2026-06-27, now classified as current. The 0% coupon and 2027-03-15 maturity were not re-read in the filing, but the maturity is consistent with current classification.

c28.note: The full $100.0M was drawn ($40M in June 2025, $60M in September 2025), leaving no availability. This comes from a search summary of the 10-Q, not the filing text itself.

c29.note: The debt note text was truncated in every fetch, so $110.9M was not found. It is plausible: $100M principal plus about $11M of accrued PIK (Q2 2026 PIK expense was $3.4M, $6.8M year to date), and the carrying value is $85.6M net of discount.

c30.note: Agreement dated 2025-05-07 with Unprocessed Foods, LLC for up to $100M. $40M was drawn on 2025-06-26 and $60M on 2025-09-18, completing the full $100M.

c31.note: The 10-Q and press release both show H1 2026 operating cash use of $23.2M against $58.0M in H1 2025 (as corrected). I did not see the 'operate at a loss' wording, which is boilerplate.

c32.note: The liquidity section of the 10-Q was not retrievable (shell parsing was blocked and WebFetch excerpts did not reach it), so the 12-month funding statement is unconfirmed.

c33.note: Search extracts of the Q1 and Q2 2026 10-Qs show a $15.0M minimum-liquidity covenant, tested quarterly, in the 2030 Notes indenture. The Loan and Security Agreement has a $15.0M liquidity floor too (2025 Q3 10-Q).

c34.note: The compliance statement was not found in the excerpts I could read. Cash of $171.4M is well above the $15M floor, so compliance is plausible.

c35.note: The notes are 7.00% second-lien PIK toggle notes with PIK at 9.5%, per the company's exchange-offer announcement and the Q1 10-Q. They were issued 2025-10-15 and mature on the fifth anniversary, so 2030-10-15. I did not see the exact date written out.

c36.note: I read about 100,000 of the 118,522 characters of the Q2 2026 10-Q and found no $60.0M cap. The last 18,522 characters were not fully readable, and a search found nothing either.

c37.note: The amounts match the release: $1,114,603,000 tendered (96.92%), $196.2M new notes, 316,150,176 shares and $208.717M total with the $12.5M SteerCo premium. Early settlement was 2025-10-15, not 10-13, per the 8-K.

c38.note: The final release says 97.16% tendered, $209.176M of new notes and $32.659M of 2027 notes remaining, not 97.44%, $209.721M and $29.459M. The 317,834,446 share count does appear in a later filing, but the release says 316,926,786.

c39.note: The filing says the Exchange Offer qualified as a troubled debt restructuring under ASC 470-60, and the Q2 10-Q repeats this.

c40.note: The cited press release does not mention Reuters, and I found no Reuters article. Other outlets (Bloomberg Law, Benzinga) reported that the swap averted default risk and heavily diluted holders.

c41.note: The release states about $148.7M net proceeds from common stock sales. The cash flow statement shows $148,699K net of issuance costs.

c42.note: The Aug 5, 2026 release says the company no longer meets Form S-3 eligibility and cannot access its ATM Program.

c43.note: The 1-for-30 split and the proportional adjustment of the 2027 and 2030 notes and warrants are confirmed. The split took effect Aug 13 (trading Aug 14); Aug 11 is the filing date. I did not confirm the authorized-share reduction.
